description: pipeline.rs:246 and rnews_config.rs:85: both functions return Result<StoreBuildResult, String>. Every internal error arm stringifies its source error (format!("S3 store init failed: {e}"), .ok_or("backend.type = 'kubo' requires ..."), etc.), discarding the source chain. Callers (rnews_main.rs:167-173) cannot distinguish config errors from network init failures; they just print the string and exit. A typed StoreError enum (variants: MissingConfig(&'static str), InitFailed { backend: &'static str, source: Box<dyn Error> }) would preserve source chains for structured logging and allow callers to classify transient vs permanent failures. ConfigError::Validation could be reused for the missing-section cases.
notes: Pre-existing: String errors in build_store is established pattern. Deferring.
title: build_store_from_parts / build_store_for_rnews return Result<_, String>
